fixture.physicalMethod: Temporary non-enumerable read-only references to actual skull and paw geometries before normal bake; exact convex skull triangle halfspaces and actual posed vertex samples, no nominal radius and no geometry/transform/render change.

audit.method: runtime noBake on actual HERO_PARTS[id].weapon only, explicit buildCat3D(lookOf(id),id); actual current buildCat3D/POSES phase=0/yaw=32; weapon outline vertex expansion; independent normal bake FRAME by applyBoneTransform on every vertex; 12x12 actual baked eye-core triangle projection plus five face landmark depth probes; baseline weapon replaced from aa9afd3270c839b3ba5aa72d2836dec3fe2d0f93, identical current engines

export.encoding: Lossless PNG optimize only; no crop, resize, recolor, art retouch or geometry/material substitution.

rawDetailedReport.exportSummary: Per-mesh physical skull-inside vertex detail is summarized to totals and mesh counts in exported JSON; all 150 face sample-ID sets, frame boxes, margins and 77 actual users remain in full.

verificationLimits.face: Conservative depth samples on actual projected baked eye-core triangles (12x12 grid per eye), and five named local nose/mouth probes. The full 150-case core check does not remove all other head/lid occlusion and does not represent all pixels. New sample IDs are compared, not only total blocked-case counts. Final new IDs are zero, including the previously found bow regression.
verificationLimits.physical: Temporary non-enumerable references to actual skull and paw meshes preserve geometries before normal bake without modifying production files, geometry, transforms or render appearance. Exact 1120 triangle convex skull halfspaces and actual posed vertices prove geometric point inclusion only. Counts differ with vertex density/shape and are not visible penetration or volume severity measures.
verificationLimits.motion: 14 discrete poses at t=.4 plus idle/windup/strike at 12 t=i*8/11 values, yaw32. Visual actual 0/±32/148 views are separate finite checks, not full continuous-motion/all-camera proof.
verificationLimits.runtime: Explicit buildCat3D(lookOf(id),id) is used throughout. 3 target x4 instrumented/normal/baseline constructions hit overrides12; 77 actual hero/mob builds hit each target override once per candidate/baseline. Existing unit tests without heroId do not cover this override path.

authorBattleRuntimeEvidence.independentReview: Read author runtime record and reviewed the resulting actual battle PNG/WebP; 10 cat3d actors and each target custom group name are recorded. This is distinct from the independent temporary 77-user construction audit.

visualConclusion.result: Final three-pose, native small scale, 0/32/-32/148 views, common-family and thrust/castFwd/guard probe views reviewed. No further source revision requested after the final sample-ID checks.
visualConclusion.leastSatisfied: At strike, the fan still presents a narrow oblique face and the laurel veins/pearls are small at native battle scale. The shortened local -1 bow ornament is less detailed at that scale, while the other end keeps its larger decorative silhouette.
